core.$description: Scales read from nomadgoods.com/sg/ on 2026-11-21. One light theme.

black.source: Measured. computed color of body and Best Sellers nav link on /sg/ at 1440x900 (raw/computed-roles.json)

white.source: Measured. computed backgroundColor of the nav bar and color of the homepage h1 (raw/measured-chrome.json, raw/computed-roles.json)
white.description: Nav bar fill and type on dark hero photography.

page.source: Measured. computed backgroundColor of body and footer on /sg/ (raw/computed-roles.json). Also the most common non-black hex in css-bundle after #000 and #fff.

inkSoft.source: Measured. .button-dark background gradient stop in buttons-FS3QHQ7I.css, fetched from the live stylesheet (cross-origin to the CSSOM).

inkDeep.source: Measured. inset shadow colour of .button-dark in buttons-FS3QHQ7I.css.

muted.source: Measured. third most common grey hex in css-bundle-PU7D35ZG.css (21 uses). Not read off a named text role.
muted.description: Secondary grey used across the bundle.

danger.source: Measured. hex in css-bundle-PU7D35ZG.css (5 uses). Role as danger is inferred from the value sitting with no other red; treat the role as Observed, the hex as Measured.
danger.description: The only red in the public stylesheet bundle.

info.description: The only blue in the public stylesheet bundle, aside from Swiper's #007aff.

sale.source: Not captured as a computed style. The Sale nav label paints orange in screenshots/home-light-default.png. The stylesheet bundle has no orange hex. Value left untokenised in light.text.sale as Not captured; this primitive is omitted from the built file if unused.

display.source: Measured. computed fontFamily of h1 and Shop Now on /sg/ (raw/computed-roles.json) and of .button-dark (raw/pdp-measured.json).

body.source: Measured. computed fontFamily of body and the Best Sellers nav link (raw/computed-roles.json).

$extensions.source: Measured. computed style of h1 '35% Off Stand One Max' on /sg/ at 1440x900 (raw/computed-roles.json).
Measured. computed style of h2 'Featured Deals' on /sg/ (raw/measured-chrome.json).
Measured. computed style of Shop Now and the PDP Sold Out button (raw/computed-roles.json, raw/pdp-measured.json).
Measured. computed style of body on /sg/ (raw/computed-roles.json). letterSpacing was 'normal', recorded as 0px.
Measured. computed style of the announcement link and .button-sm (raw/computed-roles.json, raw/pdp-measured.json).

none.source: Measured. computed borderRadius of body, nav links and headings (raw/computed-roles.json).

bar.source: Measured. computed borderRadius of the desktop nav bar (raw/measured-chrome.json).

pill.source: Measured. computed borderRadius of Shop Now and .button-dark (raw/computed-roles.json, raw/pdp-measured.json).

button-x.source: Measured. computed paddingLeft of Shop Now and the PDP primary button (raw/computed-roles.json, raw/pdp-measured.json).

nav-x.source: Measured. computed paddingLeft of the Best Sellers nav link (raw/computed-roles.json).

bar-x.source: Measured. computed paddingLeft of the nav bar (raw/measured-chrome.json).

button-md.source: Measured. bounding height of Shop Now and the PDP primary button (raw/computed-roles.json, raw/pdp-measured.json).

button-sm.source: Measured. bounding height of .button-sm skip links (raw/pdp-measured.json).

nav-bar.source: Measured. bounding height of the desktop nav bar (raw/measured-chrome.json).

breakpoint-mobile.source: Measured. configured and actual viewport width of the phone captures (public.mjs, 390x844).

button.source: Measured. transition:.15s on .button-dark in buttons-FS3QHQ7I.css, and computed transition 0.15s ease-out on the nav bar (raw/measured-chrome.json).

light.$description: Semantic roles for the only theme the public storefront paints.

inverse.source: Measured. announcement strip paints black in screenshots/home-light-default.png; announcement bar computed background was transparent on the link, so the strip fill is Observed in the screenshot and the black primitive is Measured on body text.

primary.source: Measured. body and nav link color rgb(0, 0, 0) (raw/computed-roles.json).

muted.source: Measured hex from css-bundle frequency, not from a named muted text node. See What to distrust.

primary.source: Measured. .button-dark background #2f2f2f (buttons-FS3QHQ7I.css) and computed inset shadow rgb(14, 14, 14) on the PDP button (raw/pdp-measured.json).

onPrimary.source: Measured. .button-dark color #fff and computed color of the PDP Sold Out button (raw/pdp-measured.json).

secondary.source: Measured. .button-light background gradient starts at #fff (buttons-FS3QHQ7I.css) and Shop Now paints a white pill (raw/computed-roles.json box-shadow).

danger.source: Measured hex #d02d2d in css-bundle. No error field was submitted, so the role is not confirmed on a live error state.

info.source: Measured hex #2c4a8c in css-bundle. Not confirmed on a live info banner.
